summary: Earth Jukebox is an interactive web platform that transforms NASA's scientific data and space audio into an engaging sound experience. It combines real space recordings with data sonification, allowing users to explore Earth and the universe through sound. Our goal is to make space science more accessible, interactive, and interesting for everyone.
details:
Earth Jukebox is an interactive web application that transforms scientific information about Earth into sound. It combines data sonification, audio experiences, and an interactive map to offer users a new way to explore our planet.

The project makes scientific information more engaging and accessible by allowing users to experience data through sound and visual interaction. Its potential impact is to encourage curiosity about Earth science and make complex information easier to explore.

We developed the application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in Visual Studio Code. The creative aspect of our project is the combination of scientific data, sound, and interactive visualization. Our team focused on accessibility, user experience, and making science more engaging through an alternative sensory approach.
